title: Cross-repo launcher build
desc: Core CLI uses SDK WKAppBot.Launcher as single source of truth
steps: WHY: SDK is canonical launcher. Core Launcher diverges without this; HWND fixes must be applied twice. HOW: Replace LauncherCsproj with SDK-conditional plus Core-fallback in WKAppBot.CLI.csproj. PATH: 4 parents from WKAppBot.CLI dir = D:\GitHub, append wkappbot-sdk\csharp\src\WKAppBot.Launcher\WKAppBot.Launcher.csproj. FALLBACK: SDK absent uses Core Launcher, no build break. COMMIT: ff23fde97 WKAppBot Core 2026-05-24.
